title: Several late-game 'weigh what this grief asks' free entries (a great, load-bearing UX feature) were inconsistently present — present at Fenmarch, Thornwold, Wardmoor's core grief rooms, but absent at Tithing's edge/granary steps where it was most needed to orient the player.
